short: Press a key beside a beached boat and it slides toward the nearest water until it floats. Nothing else about boats changes.

roadmap.title: Tune the slide against real boats
roadmap.body:
How deep the water must be before a boat counts as afloat, and how fast the push runs, are estimates so far. The mod has not been run in game yet.

The first play test sets both from what a raft-less karve and a longship actually do on a beach, so a boat neither stops in the shallows nor crawls the last few metres.
